cves.description: sshd in OpenSSH 6.2 through 8.x, when certain non-default configurations are used, allows privilege escalation because supplemental groups are not initialized as expected. Attackers require additional constraints to be met.
sshd in OpenSSH before 7.3, when SHA256 or SHA512 are used for user enumeration timing attack, allows remote attackers to enumerate users by observing timing differences.
OpenSSH through 7.7 is prone to a user enumeration vulnerability due to not delaying bailout for an invalid authenticating user until after the packet containing the request has been fully parsed.

remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH from version 7.4 to the latest vendor-supported release that addresses listed CVEs.
Public exploit activity indicated for: CVE-2021-41617, CVE-2016-6210, CVE-2018-15473. Prioritize emergency patching or compensating controls.
Apply vendor security advisories for: CVE-2021-41617.
Restrict network exposure of 192.168.1.100:22 via firewall/ACL until patched.
Schedule patch deployment within 72 hours; validate via rescanning.
Verify backup/restore readiness before major version upgrades.

cves.description: A flaw was found in a change made to path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49. An attacker could map URLs to files outside the directories configured by Alias-like directives. If files outside of these directories are not protected by the usual default configuration 'require all denied', these requests can succeed. If CGI scripts are also enabled, this could allow for remote code execution.

It was found that the fix for CVE-2021-41773 in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 was insufficient. An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the directories configured by Alias-like directives.

remediation: Upgrade Apache httpd from version 2.4.49 to the latest vendor-supported release that addresses listed CVEs.
Public exploit activity indicated for: CVE-2021-41773, CVE-2021-42013. Prioritize emergency patching or compensating controls.
Apply vendor security advisories for: CVE-2021-41773, CVE-2021-42013.
Restrict network exposure of 192.168.1.20:443 via firewall/ACL until patched.
Schedule patch deployment within 72 hours; validate via rescanning.
Verify backup/restore readiness before major version upgrades.

cves.description: Vulnerability in MySQL Server (component: Server: Optimizer). Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Server. Supported versions that are affected include 5.7.30 and prior.

Vulnerability in the MySQL Server product of Oracle MySQL (component: Server: Optimizer). Supported versions that are affected are 5.6.49 and prior, 5.7.31 and prior, and 8.0.21 and prior. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Server.

remediation: Upgrade MySQL from version 5.7.30 to the latest vendor-supported release that addresses listed CVEs.
Restrict network exposure of 10.0.0.55:3306 via firewall/ACL until patched.
Schedule patch deployment within 2 weeks as part of normal change windows.
Verify backup/restore readiness before major version upgrades.

cves.description: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows Server 2012 R2 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets, aka EternalBlue / WannaCry related vulnerability.

An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller, using the Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC), aka Zerologon.

cves.description: In Jenkins 2.340 through 2.346 (both inclusive), the tooltip of the build button in list views supports HTML without escaping the job display name, resulting in a stored XSS vulnerability.

Jenkins 2.277.1 through 2.346 (both inclusive) does not escape content of the tooltip on the 'Expand all'/'Collapse all' buttons, resulting in a stored XSS vulnerability exploitable by attackers with Item/Configure permission.
A sandbox bypass vulnerability exists in Script Security and Pipeline Groovy plugins related to Jenkins, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code on the Jenkins master.

remediation: Upgrade Jenkins from version 2.346 to the latest vendor-supported release that addresses listed CVEs.
